note: Eight requests the prompt was never tuned on, written with their expectations before any run that uses them. They are sent in file order, which mixes the kinds so that one timeout cannot remove a kind. A case with repeat: true is sent a second time with a new operation id. catalog names the agents offered: "bundled" is the bundled crew, any other name adds that list from `agents` to it. In a proposal, a seat's agent is written by its name and resolved against the catalog when the case is sent. expect: reply "plan" means a question is a miss, "plan_or_question" accepts the named question; changes true needs a seat that changes files and false forbids one; submitters are the agents allowed to produce the last step; loop is "warranted", "allowed" or "none"; uses must each hold a seat; keeps and drops are agents of the sent proposal that must stay or go; outrider lists the accepted values, "none" for absent. The machine-read flags are a first pass: every answer is also read by a person.
